entry.title: Why more inventory won’t fix your supply chain’s fill rate

entry.title: Runnings unites forecasting, replenishment with AI

entry.summary: The retailer will deploy Symbotic's technology at 25 regional facilities as it looks to improve speed and inventory replenishment.

entry.title: Norfolk Southern, Schneider National team to scale East Coast intermodal reach
entry.summary: The railroad’s potential merger with Union Pacific is “the icing on the cake” of the partnership, Schneider CEO Jim Filter said.

entry.title: Reshoring and foreign direct investment added 247K manufacturing jobs in 2025
entry.summary: The result “essentially matched” the previous year, per the Reshoring Initiative, which expects 25% growth in reshoring-related jobs in 2026.

entry.title: Manufacturing expands for 10th straight month, but Iran war weighs heavily
entry.summary: Increasingly negative comments from respondents also cite price vitality and trade wars in the latest Purchasing Managers’ Index from the Institute for Supply Management.

entry.title: Is warehouse demand shifting towards inland markets?
entry.summary: Uncertainty has led shippers to move an increased amount of inventory across inland markets versus port markets, according to experts, but it may not necessarily translate to a shift in demand.

entry.title: Coty upgrades warehouse lighting to slash emissions
entry.summary: As part of its sustainability strategy, Coty swapped out nearly 2,600 fixtures in a Maryland facility, cutting lighting-related energy consumption by 25%.

entry.summary: The integration plan, slated to wrap up in 2027, is already complete in markets like Dallas and San Francisco as the carrier preps for the peak season.
